title: Start with a consistent meal schedule
summary: Want more peace at the table? Start with a consistent meal schedule!
caption: Want more peace at the table? Start with a consistent meal schedule! 🕗 Breakfast at 8am 🕚 Lunch at 11am 🕑 Snack at 2pm 🕔 Dinner at 5pm 🛏️ Bedtime at 8pm Avoid grazing and random snacks between meals—this helps your child build hunger and trust around food (which means less picky eating and fewer battles). It all starts with trust—not tricks 💛 #pickyeatingtips #feedingkids #momhacks #parentingtips #plantbasedmama #momsoftiktok #pickyeaterhelp
